creator: Alexander Terp
description:
From #153, batch 13, item 8.

```rad
print(len("a\rb"))   // 4: a, \, r, b
print("\x41\q")      // \x41\q
```

On main `\r`, `\xNN` and `\u` are not escapes, and an unknown escape passes through silently with no `rad check` warning. A multipart body needs CRLF, so `"\r\n"` silently produces a malformed body; the working form is `decode_base16("0d0a")`.

Add `\r`, `\xNN` and `\u{...}`, and make an unknown escape an error or a `rad check` warning. Making it an error is breaking for scripts that rely on the passthrough (Windows paths like `"C:\Users"`).

Where: `rts/converter.go` `resolveStringPart` (the escape kinds come from the tree-sitter grammar, so this needs a tree-sitter-rad change too).
title: Add \r, \x and \u string escapes, and flag unknown escapes
